During the [[Desolator crisis]], a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] undertook a '''mission''' to the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to locate the [[Shock Drum]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Accompanied by the Knight's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], the Jedi discovered that the weapon had been stolen by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]], and that Carsen's former master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] had been left for dead with the activated Shock Drum at the orders of Praven's master [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="The Shock Drum" /> After defeating Praven in a [[Duel on the Esus Mesa|duel]] and turning the honorable [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]],<ref name="Desert Duel" /> the Knight killed the monstrous [[sand demon]] that had been drawn to the Shock Drum's vibrations and destroyed the weapon before it could destabilize Tatooine's core, saving Master Kiwiiks in the process.<ref name="The Sand Demon" />
